claim: The product root is up, answers GET /api/health with a numeric non-zero pid and exact build identity, refuses the same route without the credential, and carries no legacy `healthy` field.
Exactly one provider/model is issued by GET /api/provider and the runtime obtains a fresh typed target from the same catalog authority for its Physical Attempt.
POST /api/session returns a typed session identity and the journey continues on exactly that session.
POST /api/session/{sessionID}/prompt carries the operator credential and account header into one real protocol request; a stable-id retry reconciles without a second request.
GET /api/event carries provider reasoning, text and usage frames, then settles exactly one success terminal.
The witness establishes cursorless SSE, drops that connection before prompt execution, then recovers reasoning, text and provider-reported usage only through GET /api/session/{sessionID}/message.
After restart in a distinct shipped process, durable re-list is byte-equivalent and the controlled provider observes no repeated request.

An active stalled provider stream is interrupted over HTTP and settles exactly one interrupted terminal and no success terminal; authentication rejection and malformed SSE separately close typed failure counterexamples.
